_comment: Cards for tests/unit/costs/test_tap_x.py. `t_tx_hazel` is Hazel of the Rootbloom's mana ability without the life payment: tap X untapped tokens, add X mana in any combination of colours. `t_tx_green` is the same cost on a one-colour mana ability, so the amount alone reads X. `t_tx_engine` puts the cost on an ability that uses the stack, so the X the effect reads is visible on a life total. `t_tx_tapper` is a creature whose cost taps itself and X untapped creatures, so the source matches its own selector and must not be counted twice.
